title: Add configurable bank transfer payment option with admin-managed bank details

requirements.text: Add backend support for bank transfer details by introducing a BankDetails record (e.g., bank name, account name, account number, optional note) that can be saved by an admin and retrieved by the frontend for display to customers.

quotes: allow me to put my bank details for payment if customer purchase

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes an admin-only method to set/update bank transfer details.
Backend exposes a public query method to fetch the currently configured bank transfer details (or null/none if not configured).
Bank transfer details are persisted in canister state (survive canister upgrades).
Unauthorized callers (non-admin) cannot set/update bank transfer details (must trap with a clear error).

requirements.text: Add React Query hooks to read and (admin-only) update the bank transfer details from the backend actor, following the existing patterns used for Stripe configuration in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts.

quotes: allow me to put my bank details for payment if customer purchase

acceptanceCriteria: There is a query hook that fetches bank transfer details and caches them via React Query.
There is a mutation hook that updates bank transfer details and invalidates/refetches the cached query on success.
Hook error states are surfaced to the UI so the admin can understand failures (e.g., unauthorized, validation).

requirements.text: Provide an admin UI to configure bank transfer details (bank name, account name, account number, optional note) in a dialog accessible from the header when the admin is logged in, without editing any immutable frontend paths.

quotes: allow me to put my bank details for payment if customer purchase

acceptanceCriteria: When an authenticated admin opens the configuration dialog, they can enter and save bank transfer details.
The UI validates required fields (bank name, account name, account number) and shows clear English error messages for missing/invalid inputs.
On successful save, the dialog shows a success confirmation and the saved details are reflected in subsequent reads.
Non-admin users do not see the bank transfer configuration entry point in the header UI.

requirements.text: Add a customer-facing 'Pay via Bank Transfer' option on each data plan card that opens a modal showing the configured bank transfer details (and a short instruction block) so customers can pay by bank transfer as an alternative to Stripe and WhatsApp ordering.

quotes: allow me to put my bank details for payment if customer purchase

acceptanceCriteria: Each plan card offers a clear bank transfer action (e.g., a button) alongside the existing 'Pay Now' and 'Order via WhatsApp' flows.
The bank transfer modal displays bank name, account name, and account number (and optional note if set) in a readable layout, with a copy-friendly presentation (e.g., easy to select/copy).
If bank transfer details are not configured, the bank transfer action is hidden or disabled and the UI explains that bank transfer is currently unavailable (in English).
Adding the bank transfer option does not break the existing Stripe checkout flow or WhatsApp ordering flow for any network-specific plan.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo.
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose existing UI components instead.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not integrate any external bank/payment API for verifying bank transfers.
Do not remove or replace the existing Stripe 'Pay Now' checkout flow.
Do not add third-party authentication; continue using Internet Identity only.
